# Sprint30

Sprint30 is a 30-day challenge that builds a real side-income stream: pick a lane, ship an offer, and land your first customers. One specific mission a day, delivered to a token-gated dashboard; days 1–3 are free, the full 30 days cost $37 one-time.

## Key pages

- / — landing page: challenge pitch, free-vs-paid tiers, $37 checkout
- /privacy.html — privacy policy
- /terms.html — terms of service. All sales are final.
- /dashboard.html — token-gated 30-day mission dashboard (noindex)
- /success.html — post-Stripe confirmation (noindex)

## API

- POST /api/sprint30/checkout — creates the $37 Stripe checkout session.
- GET /api/sprint30/status?token= — token-gated dashboard status (current day, progress).
- POST /api/sprint30/progress — { token, day, done } → records mission completion.
- GET /api/sprint30/unsubscribe?token= — one-click unsubscribe, honored immediately.

## Compliance

A guided challenge, not a business-in-a-box. No income promises: missions teach a process (pick a lane, ship an offer, land customers); results depend on the participant's effort. No follower, revenue, or employment claims.

## Pricing

$37 one-time for the full 30-day challenge, via the centralized https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout. Days 1–3 free.
